$comment: Slither triage for TIER 2 (forks of audited Liquity v1 code — AUDIT_DIFF.md).
Policy: Tier-2 HIGHs fail unless an entry here cites an audited base AND the gate
mechanically proves the finding is inherited (same detector on the same function,
anchored in Tier 0/1). Tier-2 MEDIUMs fail unless listed here with a reason.
Tier-2 LOW/INFO findings are reported but not gated — the audited upstream carries
the same classes and they are accepted by Liquity's audits.
When Slither adds a detector or the forks change, the gate fails until each new
finding is either fixed or consciously added here. That is the point: zero silent
findings in the fork-kill-zone. Keep reasons short, specific and honest.
